notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content: Spooky season is upon us. So let's celebrate with a new background, card face, and card back! All will be unlockable with Squiggle Points and available year round.

notes.title: NEW WAIFU RELEASE
notes.content:
Say "Hiii~ ♥" to the newest waifu, [b]Eloise[/b]! 
This update is available for free for everyone.

She can be unlocked in the Squiggle Shop for 8500 Squiggles.
Eloise features 2 unlockable gimmicks: [b]Hairdye[/b] & [b]Neko-be-gone potion[/b].

Bugfixes & Improvements:
[list]
[*]In Gallery: Fix for unexpected behavior from gimmick switches.
[*]All Waifus: Undress animation transitions smoother to next stage.
[*]Devyn: Refined animations.
[/list]
